result.summary: Found 4 issues including a bottom navigation state inconsistency, a cut-off restaurant card, and minor text truncation problems.

issues.description: The 'Profile' tab is highlighted as active in the bottom navigation, but the visible content (Home feed with restaurant listings) corresponds to the Home screen, not a Profile page.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active navigation state matches the currently displayed screen; highlight 'Home' instead if this is the home feed.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the edge of the screen, truncating both the image and the name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or add proper horizontal scroll padding so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without ellipsis styling being clearly intentional, making it look broken rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (e.g., partial fade or peek of next card) to indicate more content is scrollable, or use proper text truncation with ellipsis.

issues.description: The pizza promotion image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add spacing or a smoother fade/gradient transition before the bottom navigation bar to avoid abrupt content cutoff.
